quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what it means to clear out someone's room and keep only three objects.
quests.explanation: Reducing a person's whole study to three kept objects is a quiet, private sign of grief.
quests.textToSpeak: She cleared out his study last weekend. She said she kept only three things.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Rereading your own name three times before believing it points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Rereading your own name to confirm a win is a joyful, almost disbelieving excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: My name is the first one listed under the scholarship recipients. I had to read it three times.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Is there any personal feeling in this sentence, or only information?
quests.explanation: A plain statement of opening hours, with no personal feeling attached, is a clear example of a neutral tone.
quests.textToSpeak: The library opens at nine and closes at five, Monday through Saturday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An anonymous act of kindness that you can't repay directly leaves a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A kind stranger's gesture you can't even thank in person is a simple, direct cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: A stranger paid for my coffee this morning and left before I could even say thank you.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A big moment feeling different from how you pictured it points to a familiar unease.
quests.explanation: Reality not matching a hundred mental rehearsals is a common cause of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've rehearsed this moment a hundred times in my head. Standing here now, it doesn't feel like I imagined.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small technical problem repeating at the worst possible moment brings a light but real irritation.
quests.explanation: A connection dropping at exactly the wrong moment, more than once, is a very relatable form of annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The wifi has dropped three times during this call already, and it's always right when it's my turn to speak.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Going silent after one bite, then asking to learn the recipe, tells you a lot about the reaction.
quests.explanation: Going quiet, then asking to be taught how to cook something, is a high compliment that shows real happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: She took one bite and went completely quiet. Then she got up, came to the kitchen, and asked me to teach her.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promise to stay close that quietly never happened points to a gentle, familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching a close friendship fade after a promise to keep it up is a quiet, common form of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: My best friend from school moved to another country last year. We said we'd video call every week. We haven't, not once.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Words that stop making sense after several rereads point to a physical and mental state.
quests.explanation: Rereading the same lines without absorbing anything is a common sign of mental tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read the same paragraph in this textbook four times tonight, and none of it is going in anymore.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Learning a major fact about someone after twenty conversations tends to bring a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Discovering an important fact about someone only after many conversations is a natural cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: I've spoken to this client twenty times, and I had no idea she was the CEO until she introduced herself at lunch.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A sudden break in someone's usual habit tends to bring on a specific, uneasy feeling.
quests.explanation: A loved one suddenly going quiet, against their usual habits, is a natural cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter hasn't answered any of my texts since this morning, and she always replies within minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Feeling your own heartbeat as a performance is about to begin points to a familiar physical sign.
quests.explanation: Feeling your heartbeat in your ears as the lights go up is a physical sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I can feel my heartbeat in my ears. The lights just went on in the auditorium.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small thing feeling enormous because of what it means to you points to a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: A small plot of land feeling like 'everything' because of its personal meaning is a clear sign of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We got the keys to the allotment and haven't stopped planning. It's only a small patch, but it feels like everything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, exact, repeating disturbance tends to bring a familiar, low-level irritation.
quests.explanation: The same disruptive habit repeating every single morning, without exception, is a classic source of annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The upstairs neighbor starts vacuuming at exactly six every single morning, weekends included.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A repeated small theft, plus denying it happened, tends to build a stronger reaction than the act alone.
quests.explanation: Being lied to repeatedly about something as small as labeled food is a common, relatable cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My roommate keeps eating my labeled food from the fridge and denying it every single time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Returning somewhere and finding even its small, sensory details have changed points to a quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Finding that even the small, remembered details of a place have vanished reflects a gentle sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I drove back through my old town, and everything was different. Even the smell of the place was gone.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeated, unexplained delays during something already a little tense tend to build a specific unease.
quests.explanation: An unexplained delay repeating for the third time, mid-flight, is a natural cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: The pilot has announced we're circling the airport for the third time now and still hasn't explained why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Forty minutes of staring at something important without opening it points to a familiar unease.
quests.explanation: Being unable to open an important email for forty minutes is a classic sign of nervous anticipation.
quests.textToSpeak: She's been staring at the unopened results email for forty minutes without clicking on it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A big promise replaced by something this unexpected tends to deflate the mood into one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Expecting something meaningful and getting interpretive dance instead is a cause of restless boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The retreat was billed as transformative. On day two, we were asked to find our spirit animal through interpretive dance.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Finally going to happen' after three years of waiting points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: An approved project after three years of proposals is a cause of genuine, long-awaited excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: We got the green light for the project. Three years of proposals, and it's finally going to happen.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A string of small, easy wins in one day points to a light, contented feeling.
quests.explanation: A day when small things fall into place without effort is a quiet, contented kind of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I found exactly what I was looking for in a shop I'd never even been in before. Some days everything just works.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A physical symptom behaving differently than it normally would points to a specific, uneasy feeling.
quests.explanation: A symptom that doesn't respond the way it usually does is a natural, common cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My chest has felt tight since yesterday, and it hasn't gone away with rest like it usually does.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A parent who used to engage fully now asking nothing at all points to a quiet, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A once-engaged parent slowly asking less and less is a gentle but real cause of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: My father doesn't ask about my work anymore. He used to have an opinion about everything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being thanked for loyalty while getting less for more money tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Paying more for less, then being thanked for it, is a common and fair cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They raised the service fee, cut the actual service, and sent a newsletter thanking us for our loyalty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Practical help from a whole group of people, freely given, points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A community rallying to help during a hard time is a clear, heartfelt cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My neighbors organized a meal rotation for us during the surgery recovery. I still don't know how to thank them all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Visibly shaking hands right before an important moment point to a familiar physical sign.
quests.explanation: Visibly shaking hands before walking through a door is a strong, physical sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I can see my hands visibly shaking. I need to get this under control before I walk through that door.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Assuming good news must be a mistake tends to point to one particular reaction.
quests.explanation: Assuming unexpectedly good news must be a mistake is a natural reaction of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: My landlord called to say he was lowering the rent. I actually asked if he'd meant to call someone else.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A whole street coming together to share one long table points to a warm, shared feeling.
quests.explanation: A neighborhood joining tables in the middle of the road for a shared celebration is a picture of collective happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole neighborhood gathered for the street party. Tables were joined together down the middle of the road.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, repeating technical hold-up with no end in sight brings a familiar, mild irritation.
quests.explanation: A machine repeatedly asking for help that never arrives is a very ordinary source of annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The self-checkout machine has asked me to wait for assistance three times now, and there's still nobody coming.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Keeping a way to reach someone but never using it points to a quiet, complicated feeling.
quests.explanation: Holding onto a contact you never actually use is a quiet, private sign of sadness about a friendship that faded.
quests.textToSpeak: I still have my old friend's number saved. I open the contact sometimes just to look at it. I never call.
